description.html: This 80x40x40 cm aquarium with 128 liters of volume offers serious space for creating an underwater biotope. A larger volume means more stable water parameters and the option to keep larger fish species.

This volume opens up the possibility of a biotope approach: recreating the natural habitat of the Amazon River, African lakes or Southeast Asia. We recommend an external filter, a CO2 system for plants and quality LED lighting.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, glass thickness matched to the volume, optional openings for filters and heaters. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
